builder.rootLabel: Accessible label of the Query, Mutation and Subscription switch.
builder.rootNames.query: GraphQL operation type that reads data.
builder.rootNames.mutation: GraphQL operation type that changes data.
builder.rootNames.subscription: GraphQL operation type that streams data.
builder.title: Button and heading of the pane that builds a query by ticking fields.
builder.paneLabel: Accessible label of the builder pane.
builder.filterLabel: Accessible label and placeholder of the field filter.
builder.expand: Accessible label of a button that opens a tree node.
builder.collapse: Accessible label of a button that closes a tree node.
builder.select: {{name}} is the name of a GraphQL field. Accessible label of a checkbox.
builder.include: {{name}} is the name of a GraphQL argument. Accessible label of a checkbox.
builder.viaFragment: Tooltip of a disabled checkbox. A fragment is a reusable GraphQL snippet.
builder.fetch: Button that downloads the GraphQL schema from the endpoint.
builder.refresh: Button that downloads the GraphQL schema again.
builder.loading: Accessible label shown while the schema downloads.
builder.syntaxError: {{message}} is a technical parser message in English.
builder.subscription: Stream as server-sent events is an interface label in Settings; use the same words as the translation of that label.
